notes.title: 🎉 Exciting News for Goblington Fans! 🎮
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076747/b266ab9810c25bdfcf1745b9340642d03619e943.jpg[/img]

I am thrilled to announce that Goblington's development is officially supported by the Press Start: Games Founding Grant! 🥳

This amazing program, organized by game – The German Games Industry Association in collaboration with the Foundation for Digital Games Culture and funded by the Minister of State for Culture and the Media, will allow me to dedicate even more time and resources to making Goblington the best game it can be. 💪✨

Thanks to this support, i will be able to:
🛠️ Work full-time on development
🎨 Collaborate with talented artists
🌟 Bring you more updates and content
✨ Bring Goblington to early-access and after that to 1.0

Check out the official hashtag #PressStart and join the celebration! 🎈

I’d love to hear your thoughts and share this journey together. Feel free to use the hashtag and spread the word! 💬💖

Thank you all for your ongoing support of Goblington. With this grant, we’re one step closer to making our goblin-filled adventure a reality! 🏰✨

PS: Exciting things are coming early next year:
💡 Kickstarter Campaign
🎵 Goblington OST Release
📢 Discord Server full of exclusive content
🛤️ Roadmap for Goblington
💡  Video Devlogs
...and so much more! 🚀

Let’s press start and dive into the future together! 🎮🍀

— Joshua from the Data Illusion Studios

notes.title: Join the Goblin Adventure at Steam Next Fest with Goblington!
notes.notes:
Greetings, goblin enthusiasts! 🐸✨

Get ready to embark on a whimsical journey through the enchanting world of Goblington during Steam Next Fest! It’s time to rally your goblin clan and prepare for some hilarious antics and strategic mischief.

In Goblington, you'll lead your lovable goblins through a vibrant, handcrafted realm filled with quirky challenges and delightful surprises. You'll need your wits and a knack for strategy as you manage resources, explore hidden treasures, and forge unique paths for your clan. Who knew being a goblin could be this much fun?

We’re thrilled to invite you to try our demo during the event. This is your chance to experience the charm and humor of Goblington firsthand! We promise plenty of giggles and maybe a few goblin-sized mishaps along the way.

So dive into the whimsical chaos of Goblington at Steam Next Fest! Don’t forget to wishlist the game, and let’s show the world what it means to be a goblin!

Also a lot of good player experiences has beend made yet. [b][u]Thanks for playing the OLD VERSIONS, QuanticFlux and Gaming Jay[/u][/b] :) !

notes.title: Winners of Goblington Steam Promo Event: : Key Giveaway 🎉
notes.notes:
Hey Goblin enthusiasts! 🧙‍♂️✨

The time has come to announce the winners of the Goblington giveaway! First of all, thank you so much to everyone who took the time to play the demo and share your thoughts. Your feedback means the world to me, and it's going to help shape the future of Goblington.

As promised, five lucky winners have been selected to receive a Steam key for the Early Access version of Goblington! Without further ado, here are the winners:

Winners:

[list]
[*] derpysphere
[*] jolson425
[*] Ferinzz
[*] Rhagon
[*] Sepidaceous
[/list]

Congratulations to the winners! 🎉 I'll be reaching out to each of you directly on Steam with your key.

For those who didn’t win this time, don't worry—there will be more opportunities in the future. In fact, in one of the upcoming updates, [b]you'll have the chance to find a hidden key within the game itself[/b]! Keep an eye out, as I’ll announce the details with the update.

In the meantime, I’ll continue working on new updates and content for Goblington, and I can’t wait to share it with you all.

Stay goblin, and see you in Goblington!

Cheers,
Joshua 🧙‍♂️

P.S. May the goblins ever be in your favor! 🏆🧙‍♂️

notes.title: Update 0.0.47 - Balancing
notes.notes:
[u][b]First: remeber to leave any kind of feedback here to participate in the key giveaway. It ends in a few days! :)[/b][/u]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] The last enemy attack would still hit the player even if the enemy had just died.
[*] For certain heros, particularly the Priest, the attack range was not updated when switching skills.
[*] The Priest’s level-up now displays the correct image in the tavern.
[*] The Samurai’s level-up now displays the correct image in the tavern.
[*] The Paladin’s level-up now displays the correct image in the tavern.
[*] Hero names in the unlocks screen are now correctly shown when hovering over them.
[*] Enemies no longer move during their death animation.
[*] Scrolling was deactivated when the mouse hovered over specific areas of the screen due to invisible RichText labels from Godot, which prevented scrolling. This is also fixed now.
[*] The Paladin sprite no longer becomes invisible when the level 3 skill is active.
[/list]

[b]Buffs:[/b]

[list]
[*] Imp: Hit chance increased to 75%.
[*] The Priest now has more durability and attacks faster.
[*] The Paladin has slightly more health and defense.
[*] The Paladin’s level 2 skill now causes a knockback effect, as long as the enemy doesn’t die instantly.
[*] The Druid’s level 3 skills have been improved.
[/list]

[b]By the way, have you ever wondered what 150 carrots look like in the tavern?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076747/0a02ac54c3dfa58edf10b4ce710aa3778a59e7c7.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.0.46 - Balancing / Small Additions
notes.notes:
[u][b]First: remeber to leave any kind of feedback here to participate in the key giveaway. It ends in a few days! :)[/b][/u]

[b]Improvements:[/b]

[b]Level Cap:[/b]

[list]
[*] Prevented players from reaching level 4 by setting the required experience points extremely high. The current level cap is 3, but it will be increased in future updates.
[/list]

[b]Enhanced Selection Menu:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added short descriptions for heroes in the selection menu for starting heroes.
[*] Included information about each hero's favorite food in the selection menu.
[/list]

[b]Notification Removal:[/b]

[list]
[*] Removed the message about potential appearances at Wayfarer's Firepit, as unlocked units now appear there daily (see below for details).
[/list]

[b]Buffs/Nerfs:[/b]

[b]Wayfarer's Firepit Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Once unlocked, Wayfarer's Firepit now contains new units every day, provided at least one unit has been unlocked.
[*] Each unit can only be hired once per run. Note: Many more heroes will be available to unlock in future updates.
[*] Reduced the initial unlock cost for Wayfarer's Firepit to 2 gold.
[/list]

[b]Building Cost Adjustments:[/b]

[list]
[*] Lumberjack now requires 3 gold to build.
[*] Stone Mine now requires 4 wood to build.
[*] Tavern now requires 3 gold to build.
[/list]

[b]Unit Cost Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Hiring Goblins now costs only 3 gold.
[*] Reduced the cost to buy units at Wayfarer's Firepit to 3 gold. Note: In future updates, different units will cost different resources.
[/list]

Many thanks to all players that gave balancing feedback, especially [b]Rhagon[/b].

Stay goblin, and see you in Goblington!

Cheers,
Joshua 🧙‍♂️
